source.title: BaT: Towards Self-Evolving Medical Research Agent with Stage Rubrics

extraction_limitations: Atoms are machine-extracted and marked needs_review; no human verification is asserted.
The generic primary-literature schema has no ML-benchmark-specific context model; benchmark systems and scores are represented with population/exposure/outcome descriptors and descriptive tags.
The paper states there are six limitations but visibly enumerates only four; the missing two were not invented.
References are provenance infrastructure and were not atomized as evidence.
